verdict.rationale: The npm registry probe verifies three.js is MIT-licensed and distributed free via npm. A free, permissive license leaves no per-title fees that could be repriced after a game ships. However, the pack contains no evidence of the license's history over time, so the 'track record of stability' part of the story is unsupported. Missing for 10: documented license history showing no changes over time, any first-party or independent statement on license or pricing stability.
